proposals: The Department of Pharmaceuticals should publish every year, within six months of the financial year’s close, a molecule-wise list of imported APIs and intermediates with each source country’s share, so the 43.45 per cent China share and the list of 97 APIs are not left at FY2023-24 figures.

Pharmexcil should publish the HS codes underlying its export total, and the value, not only the growth rate, of bulk drugs and intermediates, so its $31.1 billion figure can be bridged formally to DGCI&S’s $25.1 billion for Chapter 30 rather than by an outside reconstruction.

The Department of Pharmaceuticals should report Bulk Drugs PLI results molecule by molecule, giving capacity commissioned, utilisation and imports displaced against that molecule’s import bill, so the ₹2,192 crore of substitution can be read against dependencies such as 6-APA at 94.1 per cent from China.

The Department of Pharmaceuticals and DGCI&S should publish one pharmaceutical trade account netting exports and imports on a common HS basis, including the Chapter 29 API headings, so the formulation surplus and the intermediate-goods dependency appear on the same line.
